HOME.TITLE: CNTA connecta
HOME.SLOGAN: Connecting mobility, services, artificial intelligence and blockchain.
HOME.ABOUT_TEXT_1: CNTA connecta is a token built on the Polygon network with the purpose of delivering real utility within an ecosystem of existing apps and services.
HOME.ABOUT_TEXT_2: Our goal is to connect urban mobility, service delivery, AI-generated music content and blockchain technology under one roof.
HOME.FOUNDER_BIO_P1: I'm a developer and entrepreneur passionate about blockchain technology and urban mobility. I built the CNTA ecosystem from scratch, personally overseeing every stage: from the smart contract on Polygon to the ZapMoto, ServLink and Connecta applications.
HOME.FOUNDER_BIO_P2: I believe in real utility over empty promises: every line of code and every integration is designed to connect people, services and opportunities in a transparent and sustainable way.
HOME.FOUNDER_PILLAR_1_DESC: Apps already live with real users (ZapMoto and ServLink) before any promises are made.
HOME.FOUNDER_PILLAR_2_DESC: Real revenue from services and a portion of profits injected into token liquidity.
HOME.FOUNDER_PILLAR_3_DESC: Every major decision and goal progress is shared with the community.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_SUBTITLE: It's simple: earn points and receive real tokens
HOME.HOWTOEARN_CALLOUT: CNTA points accumulated in the apps will be converted into real CNTA tokens.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_STEP_1_DESC: Start by installing ZapMoto or ServLink, the official apps of the CNTA ecosystem.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_STEP_2_DESC: Use the services, participate in campaigns and complete goals to accumulate CNTA points daily.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_STEP_3_DESC: Your accumulated points are automatically converted into real CNTA tokens in your wallet.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_STEP_4_DESC: To withdraw your CNTA tokens, the project goals must be completed. That's why we need a strong, engaged and growing community.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_CTA_DESC: Download our official apps today and stack your first CNTA points.

WHITEPAPER.TITLE: Whitepaper
WHITEPAPER.OVERVIEW_P1: The project aims to build a unified digital ecosystem powered by apps, music content, social channels, commercial partners and a token issued on the Polygon network.
WHITEPAPER.OVERVIEW_P2: The core proposition is to create real utility for the ecosystem by growing the app base, expanding the community, producing content, generating revenue and onboarding partnerships.
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_P1: The ecosystem will run a goals-based rewards program anchored on measurable growth and development KPIs.
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_L2: Listeners and legitimate plays of music content
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_L3: Growth and engagement on social media
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_L4: Companies and partners integrated into the ecosystem
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_L5: Revenue generated by products and services
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_L6: Other relevant metrics for the sustainable growth of the project
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_P3: Each goal will have predefined criteria and a dedicated token allocation as its reward.
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_P4: Tokens associated with a goal are only unlocked once the published criteria are met. If a goal is not reached, the tokens remain locked in the rewards reserve.
WHITEPAPER.DISTRIBUTION_P1: Once a goal is completed, unlocked tokens may be distributed among eligible participants through a points-based contribution system.
WHITEPAPER.DISTRIBUTION_P2: The intent is to deliver a distribution proportional to each participant's contribution to the growth of the ecosystem, using transparent criteria and mechanisms designed to reduce fraudulent or artificial activity.
WHITEPAPER.DISTRIBUTION_P3: Cnta points earned by users within ecosystem apps (such as ZapMoto, ServLink and Connecta) will be converted into real CNTA tokens according to the conversion rate and redemption windows established beforehand.
WHITEPAPER.DISTRIBUTION_P4: The official points-to-tokens conversion table will be published before the redemption program goes live, always respecting the available balance in the rewards reserves unlocked by the completion of project goals.
WHITEPAPER.SUST_P1: The project will pursue revenue through advertising, sponsorships, commercial partnerships, content monetization, technology services and other ecosystem-aligned activities.
WHITEPAPER.SUST_P2: Revenue generation will not rely exclusively on token trading.
WHITEPAPER.SUST_P3: A liquidity policy may allocate a portion of the ecosystem's net profit to the token's liquidity pool. As an initial benchmark, up to 10% of net profit may be allocated, provided the financial result is positive and operational, tax and legal obligations are duly accounted for.
WHITEPAPER.SUST_P4: Adding liquidity is meant to strengthen the token's market health and does not constitute a guarantee of price appreciation, financial return or capital recovery.
WHITEPAPER.TRANS_P1: Transparency will be one of the project's core principles.
WHITEPAPER.TRANS_P2: The official website may feature a public dashboard containing:
WHITEPAPER.TRANS_P3: Periodic reports will be published to show the project's evolution, allowing the community to track results, completed goals, incomplete goals and reserve usage.
WHITEPAPER.PRINCIPLE_P1: The project strives to establish a sustainable cycle:
WHITEPAPER.FINAL_P1: The token is presented as part of the infrastructure and participation layer of the ecosystem, with no promise of appreciation or guaranteed financial return.
WHITEPAPER.FINAL_P2: The definitive rules for tokenomics, distribution, rewards and liquidity will be published before official implementation and may be submitted to legal and accounting review in accordance with applicable law.

HELP.FAQ_1_A: CNTA connecta is a token on the Polygon network that powers a full app ecosystem, including urban mobility, services, an AI music platform and much more.
HELP.FAQ_2_A: You can acquire CNTA on Uniswap over the Polygon network using the project's official smart contract address.
HELP.FAQ_3_A: Currently, ZapMoto and ServLink are already integrated. The Connecta app and other ecosystem services will accept the token in the near future.
HELP.FAQ_4_Q: How does the rewards program work?
HELP.FAQ_4_A: The rewards program is based on measurable ecosystem growth goals. Each completed goal unlocks tokens that are distributed among participants.
HELP.FAQ_5_Q: Does the token have real utility?
HELP.FAQ_5_A: Absolutely! CNTA can be used for cashback, in-app service payments, participation rewards and exclusive perks across the entire ecosystem.
HELP.FAQ_6_A: CNTA lives on the Polygon (MATIC) network, ensuring fast transactions and low network fees for every user.
